question: Should passive doctor diagnostics read last-known facts from the active Gateway memory manager, or should llama.cpp facts be explicitly limited to the current deep probe?
rationale: The canonical issue and docs promise facts from an already-initialized runtime, while the patch reads a transient status manager; the intended diagnostic source determines the correct lifecycle and API boundary.

options.title: Use active snapshot
options.body: Expose a process-lifecycle-owned snapshot from the default memory manager for passive doctor output and keep deep probing as a separate source.

options.title: Make diagnostics probe-only
options.body: Narrow the implementation and docs so facts appear only when the current deep command initializes its transient provider.

options.title: Keep diagnostics plugin-local
options.body: Defer Gateway exposure until a general active-runtime diagnostics seam is approved.

recommendation.title: Use active snapshot
recommendation.body: Expose a process-lifecycle-owned snapshot from the default memory manager for passive doctor output and keep deep probing as a separate source.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent owns the canonical issue and implementation and authored the current lifecycle path that must define the intended semantics.
